script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let forceStopTurn be this state → get-curr-battle-phase-conf with (arg)'s 'forceStopTurn'.
Let v be false.
If forceStopTurn, then set v to the numeric entry forceStopTurn in the battle settings of the group of executer is less than this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn").
Otherwise, set v to true.
Return not not v and call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransitionV2.helper.shouldChangeBattlePhase.apply with (this state, arguments).

flow.text: Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let forceStopTurn be this state → get-curr-battle-phase-conf with (arg)'s 'forceStopTurn'.

yes.text: Set v to the numeric entry forceStopTurn in the battle settings of the group of executer is less than this state → countup-snippet → get with (arg, "currBattlePhaseTurn").

flow.text: Return not not v and call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransitionV2.helper.shouldChangeBattlePhase.apply with (this state, arguments).

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransitionV2.helper.updateEveryFrame with (arg).
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.
If executer has the INVINCIBLE status, then
  Add the elapsed battle time to globalRegister's 'perfectDefenceTime'.
  Let number be the numeric entry "time_of_perfect_defence" in the battle settings of the group of executer.
  If globalRegister's 'perfectDefenceTime' is at most number, then stop.
  Executer uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "03"}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: [the INVINCIBLE status]}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.

flow.text: Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let globalRegister be the register of arg's 'parent'.

yes.text: Add the elapsed battle time to globalRegister's 'perfectDefenceTime'.
Let number be the numeric entry "time_of_perfect_defence" in the battle settings of the group of executer.

Executer uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "03"}], [{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: [the INVINCIBLE status]}]]} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
